picture.description: Photo of a scale model of the rover in a display case at an exhibition on 8 November 2026, seen from the left side and a little from the front; before sending, everything outside the model (people behind the case, two astronaut figurines, floor and reflections) was painted white
picture.credit: Dan Lee-Odinson (team member's own photo of a scale model)

simplifications: Made from a photo of a scale model, not of the vehicle; the model may differ from the current design.
The picture shows the left side and a little of the front; the generator guessed the right side, the back and the underside.
A figurine stood in front of the rear wheel in the photo, so the rear wheels came out only as partial arcs.
The dish antenna came out as a rough lump, and thin parts (masts, ladder) are rough.
The generated shape is slightly warped: it rests on one middle wheel, and the other wheels are 6 to 17 cm above the ground.
Scaled evenly to JAXA's height of 4.85 m for the full-size vehicle; width and length are measured from the shape and shown beside JAXA's 4.84 m and 6.44 m for comparison.
All colours, textures and markings removed; one plain grey material.

finishing.material: one neutral material; every texture, image, UV coordinate, per-vertex colour and original material removed
